title: Clan troops fight
changes: Clan troops now really fight: they hunt the monsters of their land and attack heroes sworn to rival clans.
Your own clan's soldiers are your allies: their names show green and your blows never hurt them.
Strike a clan's soldiers without an oath and that clan hunts you in all its lands for 2 minutes.
Felling enemy soldiers in their own land earns valor for your clan and renown for you.
